notes: Universitywide and NUpath policies are linked but not fully expanded.
Open elective ranges and conditional placement substitutions require individual review.
Topical electives require 16 semester hours and at least one course from each of three lists; minimum distribution semantics remain explicit in source summaries and require individual review.
The overview prohibits specified combinations with biology, marine biology/science and environmental/sustainability programs; these restrictions are preserved as a policy note.
Credits use the catalog’s stated semester hours. Bundle credits belong to requirement nodes, not to each bundled course. Alternative-course blank cells remain unknown.
Course categories are editorial taxonomy. Outcomes summarize explicit program-overview statements; they are not measured graduate outcomes.
Major-page tables and footnotes are represented; partial status explicitly excludes a full-degree completeness claim.

Official subject-catalog metadata checked for 6 courses. Description summaries are editorial paraphrases of those course descriptions; prerequisite text preserves the catalog conditions. Semester units are corroborated by the program catalog.
